name: Mateo Silva Reyes
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began, unusually, with a passion for model airplanes. The intricate designs and precise construction sparked an interest in composite materials that he pursued through technical college in Santiago. After graduating top of his class, he spent two years working for a firm specializing in carbon fiber components for the aerospace industry. Longing for a faster pace, he leveraged his experience to land a role with a Formula 3 team in South America, where he honed his skills in a high-pressure environment.

His approach to composite repair and fabrication is deeply pragmatic. Mateo prioritizes functionality and reliability above all else, believing that a well-executed, simple solution is often superior to a complex one. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly assess damage and devise effective repair strategies. Now at Caterham Motorsport, Mateo aims to bring his experience and methodical approach to contribute to the team's success.

What sets Mateo apart is his quiet confidence and his ability to remain calm under pressure. He's the type of technician who can troubleshoot a complex problem with minimal fuss, always focused on finding a practical solution. His ability to adapt and learn quickly makes him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Mateo is of medium height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always has a small notebook and pen in his pocket, even in the garage.
Meticulously cleans his tools after every use.
Refuses to listen to music while working, claiming it distracts him.
